psalm-30-1.verse: I will extol You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
psalm-30-1.prayer: Lord, I exalt You because You have lifted me up and carried me through difficult seasons. Thank You for Your faithfulness and deliverance.

psalm-30-2.verse: O Lord my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
psalm-30-2.prayer: Father, when I cried out to You, You heard me. Thank You for listening to my prayers and bringing healing to my heart and soul.

psalm-30-3.verse: O Lord, You have brought up my soul from Sheol; You have kept me alive, that I would not go down to the pit.
psalm-30-3.prayer: Lord, thank You for rescuing me from despair and giving me new life, hope, and purpose through Your grace.

psalm-30-4.verse: Sing praise to the Lord, you His godly ones, And give thanks to His holy name.
psalm-30-4.prayer: Father, help me join with Your people in giving thanks and praising Your holy name for all You have done.

psalm-30-5.verse: For His anger is but for a moment, His favor is for a lifetime; Weeping may last for the night, But a shout of joy comes in the morning.
psalm-30-5.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your anger is temporary but Your favor lasts a lifetime. Remind me that seasons of sorrow will not last forever.

psalm-30-6.verse: Now as for me, I said in my prosperity, “I will never be moved.”
psalm-30-6.prayer: Father, protect me from pride and self-reliance. Help me remember that every blessing comes from Your hand.

psalm-30-7.verse: O Lord, by Your favor You have made my mountain to stand strong; You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
psalm-30-7.prayer: Lord, when I feel secure, help me continue depending upon You. When difficulties come, remind me that You are my strength.

psalm-30-8.verse: To You, O Lord, I called, And to the Lord I made supplication:
psalm-30-8.prayer: Father, I call upon You in every circumstance. Thank You that I can always come before You in prayer.

psalm-30-9.verse: “What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your faithfulness?
psalm-30-9.prayer: Lord, help me use my life to glorify You. Let every day be an opportunity to honor and worship You.

psalm-30-10.verse: “Hear, O Lord, and be gracious to me; O Lord, be my helper.”
psalm-30-10.prayer: Father, hear my prayer and have mercy upon me. Be my helper and guide through every challenge I face.

psalm-30-11.verse: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing; You have loosed my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
psalm-30-11.prayer: Lord, thank You for turning mourning into joy. Restore hope where there is discouragement and bring peace where there is pain.

psalm-30-12.verse: That my soul may sing praise to You and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever.
psalm-30-12.prayer: Father, let my heart continually praise You. May gratitude, worship, and thanksgiving fill my life every day.

psalm-30-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your healing, restoration, and faithfulness. When I walk through difficult seasons, remind me that joy comes through Your presence and that Your favor endures forever. Turn my sorrow into praise, strengthen my faith, and help me live a life filled with gratitude and worship. May my heart continually honor You for all You have done and all You continue to do.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
